subject: Next steps: Compliance intake & CAIQ handoff — MedTech Plus
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medtechplus.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T14:12:00Z
Subject: Next steps: Compliance intake & CAIQ handoff — MedTech Plus

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have alignment: 

1) Scope: MedTech Plus is evaluating Redwood for inference of diagnostic-assist models (PHI-light workflows) — primary concerns were data residency, SOC 2 evidence, and CAIQ/SIG completion.
2) Primary asks from your side: SOC 2 status & date, CAIQ/SIG intake, and a brief network diagram to confirm egress points.
3) Redwood deliverables: SOC 2 cert copy or SOC 2 Type II report excerpt, completed SIG prefilling (we can provide a CAIQ-compatible spreadsheet), and a short network topology doc for architecture review.

Proposed timeline:
- By Tue (10/13): we share CAIQ-prefill spreadsheet and the SOC 2 cover page + control scope summary.
- By Fri (10/16): we aim to return the SIG-prefilled file with notes on any control gaps and proposed mitigations.

Questions for you (so we can size effort):
- Do you require HIPAA Business Associate Agreement language, or will a Data Processing Addendum + SOC 2 suffice for initial security review?
- Will your security team accept a prefilling of the SIG/CAIQ, or do you need us to complete a vendor portal directly?

I’m attaching the quick intake checklist we used on the call. I’ll begin the CAIQ prefill and loop in Marissa for SOC2 artifacts.

Best,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: intake_checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medtechplus.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medtechplus.com>, security@medtechplus.com
Date: 2026-10-12T09:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Next steps: Compliance intake & CAIQ handoff — MedTech Plus

Thanks Karthik — this is very helpful. A few clarifications from security: 

- SOC 2: We need the Type II report if available; if not, please provide the cert + timeline for Type II completion.
- HIPAA: We do handle limited PHI; for now please include a BAA template if you have one — our legal will validate.
- SIG vs CAIQ: CAIQ/X is fine — we prefer a prefilling Excel plus a PDF narrative for any non-standard answers. Can you prefill the CAIQ columns and mark anything that needs a technical artifact?

I’m attaching our vendor intake template and the CAIQ we typically use. We also need a high-level network topology that shows outbound egress destinations for model calls (IPs/domains).

We’re hoping to have the security review started this week. If you can meet the timeline you proposed that would be ideal.

Elena
Head of Security Operations
MedTech Plus
[Attachment: MedTechPlus_VendorIntake_Template.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: MedTechPlus_CAIX_Template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medtechplus.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-13T16:44:00Z
Subject: Re: Next steps: Compliance intake & CAIQ handoff — MedTech Plus

Elena — thanks, noted. Quick answers and a couple of clarifying asks so we prefill correctly: 

- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report (covering Infra + Platform controls) with a reporting period ending 2026-06-30. Marissa will attach the cert and a one-page control scope.
- HIPAA/BAA: We have a standard BAA template; I’ll include it. For initial intake it’s fine to exchange the template — legal review can happen in parallel.
- CAIQ prefill approach: We will prefill the Excel with our answers and add a "Required Evidence" column where we flag documents (e.g., control narratives, diagrams).

A couple of clarifying questions for your security reviewers so we don’t guess: 
- For network topology, do you need private IPs/subnets illustrated or will a logical diagram with outbound domains/IP ranges suffice?
- Who will be the primary security reviewer (name/email) for follow-up on evidence pulls and a single point to upload artifacts?

Next actions (my side):
- EOD 10/13: send CAIQ-prefill (Excel) + SOC2 cover page + BAA template.
- EOD 10/15: return completed CAIQ + a short narrative PDF for any nonstandard answers.

Ben — looping you in for the pricing/architecture questions that might arise. Marissa — requesting the SOC 2 files + short scope doc (see timeline).

Regards,
Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medtechplus.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Next steps: Compliance intake & CAIQ handoff — MedTech Plus

Karthik / Elena — adding the SOC2 artifacts and a short evidence pack. Attached: SOC2_cover_page.pdf (cert + auditor), controls_scope.pdf (list of in-scope systems), and network_topology.pdf (logical egress diagram).

A few practical notes for Elena/security team:
- The SOC 2 Type II full report is available under NDA; the cover page + auditor letter should be sufficient to start the intake. If you need the full report we can expedite an NDA and a secure upload link.
- Network topology: attached is a logical diagram showing outbound domains for inference API calls and the public egress ranges the hosted service uses. If you need CIDR-level detail we can provide an exported list, but that will require a short change control review.

Attachments included:
- SOC2_cover_page.pdf 
- controls_scope.pdf
- network_topology.pdf
- MedTechPlus_SIG_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (prefill in progress; will send final by 10/16)

Karthik — I flagged three CAIQ items in the sheet where we need a technical artifact (key management, customer data partitioning, and logging retention policy). I’ll follow up with the artifacts this week.

Marissa
Head of Trust & Security, Redwood Inference
